messages:
tanvi: noticing weird provisional credits for tiny streaming heartbeats from healthcheck proxy hitting toolcall path, looks like 1-2 token charges per recon.

sam: can you paste logs? is it the prefetch sidecar or router? :thinking:

tanvi: router logs show reconnect loop -> new session id -> backend treats as fresh streaming toolcall and charges prefix tokens. snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T12:01:05Z] session=abc123 reconnect
[2026-03-21T12:01:05Z] route=canary-v2 -> toolcall /v1/run
[2026-03-21T12:01:05Z] charge=provisional tokens=2
```

jess: oh that path should be idempotent. sounds like session id isn't preserved across reconnects when proxied through the healthcheck aggregator.

sam: can we treat probe pings as non-billable? but risk masking legit recon.

tanvi: idea: mark short toolcalls (<200ms) with `x-proxy-signal: probe` and have billing ignore if prefix-only and flagged. safe?

jess: feels risky, better to dedupe by `original_session_id` header propagated by router. infra-bot: note created ticket INFRA-782

tanvi: infra-bot: thanks. created quick test branch that preserves orig-session header in sidecar: https://git.redwood/infra/sidecar/compare/fix/proxy-session

sam: quick QA: run load generator with intermittent reconnects and verify ledger entries collapse to single provisional->confirmed flow.

jess: also console UX ask: add a meter that shows "probe vs user traffic" breakouts so we can tune filters without hiding real usage.

tanvi: agreed. opened console ticket CONSOLE-104. provisional fix rolling to canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: fine but add a guard: don't ignore charges until we see >95% of sessions with `probe` header from same IP range.

tanvi: noted. will add sampling flag and rollout gate.

jess: thanks — cc @billing-team for potential refund policy impact.

billing-team: noted. if rollout affects past invoices we'll prepare reconciliations.

sam: ok closing, followups in INFRA-782 and CONSOLE-104.
